headlines.title: Arsenal beat Hull to extend lead at top of the table
headlines.description: Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard scores the winner as his side beat Hull City to extend their lead at the top of the Premier League table.

headlines.title: Another 1-0 for relentless Arsenal - but did Odegaard spare VAR blushes?
headlines.description: Arsenal move six points clear at the top of the Premier League after beating Hull City - but did Martin Odegaard's goal save the blushes of the VAR?

headlines.title: Arsenal should have been awarded penalty against Hull - Cann
headlines.description: Former Premier League assistant referee Darren Cann explains why Arsenal should have been awarded a penalty for a foul on Kai Havertz in the Premier League champions' 1-0 win over Hull City.
